deployment.rustfs_beta_10_deviation: raw RustFS evaluates an unsatisfiable Range before a failing If-Match; the adapter preserves RFC 9110/AWS precondition-before-Range semantics
deployment.cursor_key_lifecycle: managed HMAC retirement ledger retains verification material for token TTL plus configured clock skew
deployment.slatedb_role: optional owner-bound rebuildable advisory index with automatic corruption quarantine and durable rebuild checkpoints

put_object.logical_retry_limit: 0..=16 repository ref-conflict retries; independent of AWS SDK transport retries
put_object.deadline_semantics: pre-I/O expiry is Timeout; in-flight expiry is OutcomeUnknown with ReconcileOperation and the stable operation ID
put_object.semantics: one logical version and one bucket commit

get_object.deadline_semantics: bounds response creation; expiry is retry-safe Timeout; returned body streaming is caller-owned
get_object.semantics: current, selected-version, or pinned-snapshot streaming read
get_object.condition_precedence: If-Match suppresses If-Unmodified-Since; If-None-Match suppresses If-Modified-Since; preconditions are evaluated before range satisfiability
get_object.range_errors: malformed syntax is InvalidRequest; syntactically valid unsatisfiable ranges are InvalidRange

head_object.deadline_semantics: bounds metadata response creation; expiry is retry-safe Timeout

delete_objects.semantics: all requested delete markers publish in one commit

list_objects_v2.deadline_semantics: bounds the immutable snapshot-pinned listing operation; expiry is retry-safe Timeout
list_objects_v2.pagination: HMAC-authenticated and pinned to one commit

multipart.catalog_pagination: HMAC-authenticated upload-id markers bind repository, bucket, branch, prefix, immutable catalog snapshot, offset, last key, and expiry
multipart.catalog_snapshot_gc: immutable snapshots remain retained through cursor expiry and become exact-version GC candidates after grace
multipart.completion_validation: part order, existence, ETags, 5 MiB nonfinal minimum, 5 GiB part maximum, 10000-part maximum, and repository object-size maximum are checked before the Active-to-Completing CAS
multipart.semantics: parts are durable but invisible; active uploads have snapshot-stable paged listing and expiry; completion publishes one commit

repository.log_pagination: exclusive commit cursor on an exact immutable first-parent chain; page capped at 1000
repository.diff_pagination: exclusive raw-key cursor between exact immutable commits; structural streaming with at most limit plus one retained entries
repository.merge_operation_replay: two-parent input reconstruction with source/base/policy identity check
repository.sync_semantics: matching repository identity; selected reachable missing closure only; destination-local CAS checkpoint pins the source head and resumes by sorted relative object path; immutable copy before explicit expected-head destination ref CAS
repository.gc_checkpointed_mark: durable running/completed operation record fixes planning time and request identity; restart safely recomputes canonical reachability before CAS-publishing an immutable exact-version plan
repository.gc_delete_rate_limit_per_second: 0 or 1..=1000; bound into the run at creation
repository.native_ref_version_retention: all physical ref versions retained indefinitely in v1
repository.gc_semantics: persisted exact-physical-version plan, failed-closed active publication fence, current retained-root recheck, CAS checkpointed batches, paced exact deletes, generation-checked reason-bearing operator abort
